cmd: mysql -uoulad -poulad -t oulad_dw -e "SELECT 'fact_vle_weekly' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM fact_vle_weekly UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_assessment_submission', COUNT(*) FROM fact_assessment_submission UNION ALL SELECT 'agg_pres_week_activity', COUNT(*) FROM agg_pres_week_activity UNION ALL SELECT 'agg_enrollment_week', COUNT(*) FROM agg_enrollment_week UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_enrollment', COUNT(*) FROM dim_enrollment; SELECT e.code_module, e.code_presentation, e.id_student, w.week_num, a.activity_type, f.sum_click, f.active_days FROM fact_vle_weekly f JOIN dim_enrollment e USING (enrollment_key) JOIN dim_course_week w USING (week_key) JOIN dim_activity a USING (activity_key) WHERE e.enrollment_key = 151 AND w.week_num BETWEEN 1 AND 4 ORDER BY w.week_num, f.sum_click DESC;" 2>/dev/null
